Congress leader from Adilabad Bhargav Deshpande with BRS working president after joining the party, in Hyderabad on Sunday. | Photo Credit: By Arrangement
Senior Congress leader of Adilabad district Bhargav Deshpande has joined the Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) here on Sunday in the presence of its working president K.T. Rama Rao.
He was invited into the party by Mr. Rama Rao who presented him the party scarf. Senior BRS leaders from the district Jogu Ramanna, MLAs Kova Laxmi and Anil Jadav, Balka Suman, Johnson Naik, senior leader V. Prashanth Reddy, and MLC Pochampally Srinivas Reddy, were present on the occasion.
Mr. Deshpande criticised the Congress leadership of Telangana stating that it was not the original Congress and there was a huge difference between the Congress he joined in 2006 and the Congress now (in 2026).
